title: Wren and the Harbor
author: Rafael Okonkwo
blurb: Marguerite Winterbourne, a vineyard owner who inherited debts instead of grapes, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. Then a lost letter surfaces, postmarked eleven years ago — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must let someone stay after the last train leaves, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
